hooks.name: Schema v0.1 freeze guard
hooks.description: Guards Schema v0.1 freeze — any write that could alter node/edge types, ID rules, or quality policy requires explicit user confirmation first.

action.prompt:
Before this file write, check whether it would:
- Add or remove a node type (Job/Skill/Occupation/Credential) or edge type
- Change deterministic ID rules (job:<id>, skill:<key>, occ:<CodeNo>, credential:<key>)
- Alter confidence policy, assertion_status handling, or requirement_level enum values
- Modify the extraction JSONL contract (§3.4)
- Change statistical_eligible policy

If ANY of the above: STOP, do NOT proceed, and ask the user for two-person approval.
If none of the above: proceed normally.
